user.title: Connect to YoLink Local Hub
user.description: Enter your YoLink Local Hub credentials. If the hub is connected by both Ethernet and Wi-Fi, set the second address as an optional fallback.

data_description.hub_ip: The hub address normally used by Home Assistant, for example the Ethernet hostname or IP address.
data_description.secondary_hub_ip: Optional fallback address for the same hub, typically the Wi-Fi hostname or IP address when the primary address is Ethernet, or the Ethernet address when the primary address is Wi-Fi.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure YoLink Local Hub
reconfigure.description: Enter your YoLink Local Hub credentials. If the hub is connected by both Ethernet and Wi-Fi, set the second address as an optional fallback.

data_description.hub_ip: The hub address normally used by Home Assistant, for example the Ethernet hostname or IP address.
data_description.secondary_hub_ip: Optional fallback address for the same hub, typically the Wi-Fi hostname or IP address when the primary address is Ethernet, or the Ethernet address when the primary address is Wi-Fi.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the hub

get_lock_users.name: Get lock users
get_lock_users.description: List the user slots that are in use on a YoLink lock.

get_lock_user_credentials.name: Get lock user credentials
get_lock_user_credentials.description: List the PINs, fingerprints, cards and fobs registered to a lock user.

include_codes.name: Show full codes
include_codes.description: Return codes in full instead of masked (only the last two digits shown).

add_lock_pin.name: Add lock PIN
add_lock_pin.description: Add a 4-8 digit PIN to a lock user. Use an unused slot to add a new user.

uses.name: Number of uses
uses.description: How many times the PIN works; 0 = unlimited.

daily_start.name: Daily start
daily_start.description: Optional time of day the code starts working.

daily_end.name: Daily end
daily_end.description: Optional time of day the code stops working.

enroll_lock_credential.name: Enroll lock fingerprint/card/fob
enroll_lock_credential.description: Put the lock into enrollment mode for a user; then scan the finger, card or fob at the lock.

delete_lock_credential.name: Delete lock credential
delete_lock_credential.description: Remove one PIN, fingerprint, card or fob from a lock user.

credential_id.name: Credential ID
credential_id.description: ID from Get lock user credentials.

delete_lock_user.name: Delete lock user
delete_lock_user.description: Remove a lock user and all of their credentials.

get_lock_temporary_codes.name: Get lock temporary codes
get_lock_temporary_codes.description: List temporary guest codes on the lock.

code_type.name: Code type
code_type.description: Only list this type; leave empty for all.

include_codes.name: Show full codes
include_codes.description: Return codes in full instead of masked (only the last two digits shown).

add_lock_temporary_code.name: Add lock temporary code
add_lock_temporary_code.description: Add a guest code: one_time (single use), time_range (valid between start and end) or recurring (on given days within start-end). Max 3 per type.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the code becomes valid (required for time_range/recurring).

end.name: End
end.description: When the code expires (required for time_range/recurring).

days.name: Days
days.description: Recurring codes: days the code works, as the lock expects them (e.g. weekday or day-of-month values).

daily_start.name: Daily start
daily_start.description: Optional time of day the code starts working.

daily_end.name: Daily end
daily_end.description: Optional time of day the code stops working.

code_id.name: Code ID
code_id.description: ID from Get lock temporary codes.
